Name: SOUND_ASSET_SOUND_OBJ_ENABLE_DIST_PARAM_ST
Description: How close the listener must be for an asset's sounds to be loaded. An asset whose bank has no row keeps its sounds loaded all the time.

Fields.Name: Sound Enable Distance
Fields.Description: Distance in metres from the listener within which the asset's sound bank is loaded and its sounds can play; it is released again when the listener moves away. 0 or less: always loaded.
